The weather was snowy that day. David thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. Last Tuesday, David and Amy went to the community center. In fact, the teacher repeated the question slowly.
Both of them like dumplings and water. It takes twenty minutes to get to the community center by bike. David wrote about the day in the diary. By a strange twist of fate, they met again.
David spent the weekend at the library. Amy's birthday is in September. They took many photos at the bus card machine. We have a meeting on Monday.
There are always many people at the bus card machine. David learned a lot about science. David is going to travel to Chengdu in September.
